items.title: Exercise-based rehabilitation interventions for kinesiophobia after total knee arthroplasty: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A systematic review of 11 RCTs (N=1,096) found that exercise-based rehabilitation was associated with a reduction in kinesiophobia (SMD = -1.22, 95% CI [-1.72, -0.72]) and improvements in knee function (SMD = 1.19, 95% CI [0.67, 1.71]) after total knee arthroplasty, although the certainty of evidence was low for both outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 本系统综述发现，运动康复能显著降低全膝关节置换术（TKA）患者的运动恐惧症（kinesiophobia）并改善膝关节功能，效应量分别为 SMD -1.22 和 1.19。尽管证据确定性为低，但这一结果支持在 TKA 术后康复中更积极地整合运动干预。
items.titleZh: 基于运动的康复干预对全膝关节置换术后运动恐惧症的影响：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 11 项随机对照试验（N=1,096）的系统综述显示，基于运动的康复干预可显著降低全膝关节置换术后患者的运动恐惧症（SMD = -1.22）并改善膝关节功能（SMD = 1.19），但证据确定性较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review found that exercise-based rehabilitation significantly reduced kinesiophobia (SMD -1.22) and improved knee function (SMD 1.19) after total knee arthroplasty (TKA). Despite low certainty of evidence, these findings support more active integration of exercise into TKA post-operative rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 该综述证据确定性低，且存在显著异质性及偏倚风险，短期疼痛结局不稳健。
items.limitationEn: The review has low certainty of evidence, significant heterogeneity, and risk of bias, with non-robust short-term pain outcomes.

items.title: Factors associated with Severe Balance Impairment After Right-Hemisphere Stroke: The Role of Spatial Neglect and Lateropulsion: A Secondary Analysis of Multicenter Cross-Sectional Study POSTIM.
items.summary: In 82 right-hemisphere stroke patients with postural asymmetry, 74% had severe balance impairment (BBS <45/56). Spatial neglect (OR 11.15), lateropulsion (OR 3.54), and lower-limb motor deficit (OR 0.91) were independently associated with severe balance impairment.
items.curatedReason: 右半球卒中（RHS）患者即使恢复了无支撑站立，仍有高比例存在严重的平衡障碍，且与空间忽视和躯体偏斜独立相关。在评估和干预 RHS 患者的平衡障碍时，你应着重筛查并针对这些神经心理因素。
items.titleZh: 右半球卒中后严重平衡障碍的相关因素：空间忽视和躯体偏斜的作用：一项多中心横断面研究 POSTIM 的次要分析
items.summaryZh: 在 82 例伴有姿势不对称的右半球卒中患者中，74% 存在严重平衡障碍（BBS <45/56）。空间忽视（OR 11.15）、躯体偏斜（OR 3.54）和下肢运动缺陷（OR 0.91）与严重平衡障碍独立相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: A high proportion of right-hemisphere stroke (RHS) patients experience severe balance impairment even after recovering unsupported standing, and this is independently associated with spatial neglect and lateropulsion. When assessing and intervening in balance deficits for RHS patients, you should prioritize screening for and addressing these neuropsychological factors.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性横断面分析，无法建立因果关系，且患者样本量有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cross-sectional analysis, precluding causal inference, and has a limited patient sample size.

items.title: Convergent validity of the Functional Bridge Test and its prognostic association with walking independence in patients with acute stroke: a retrospective cohort study.
items.summary: The Functional Bridge Test (FBT) demonstrated adequate convergent validity with NIHSS (ρ = -0.668) and FSS-ICU scores (ρ = 0.730) and was independently associated with walking independence (adjusted OR = 1.786, 95% CI = 1.022-3.418) in 207 patients with acute stroke.
items.curatedReason: 功能性搭桥测试（FBT）与 NIHSS 评分和 FSS-ICU 评分有良好关联性，并且独立预测卒中患者的步行独立性。这个简单易行的床旁评估工具在急性卒中患者中具有不错的效度和预后价值，值得你考虑作为常规评估手段。
items.titleZh: 功能性搭桥测试的聚合效度及其与急性卒中患者步行独立性的预后关联：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 功能性搭桥测试（FBT）在 207 例急性卒中患者中，与 NIHSS 评分（ρ = -0.668）和 FSS-ICU 评分（ρ = 0.730）显示出良好的聚合效度，并且与步行独立性独立相关（调整后 OR = 1.786）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Functional Bridge Test (FBT) shows good correlation with NIHSS and FSS-ICU scores and independently predicts walking independence in stroke patients. This simple bedside assessment tool has decent validity and prognostic value for acute stroke, making it a worthy addition to your routine assessments.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，且随访终点基于出院时间而非标准化时间点，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study with a variable discharge-based endpoint, which may introduce selection bias.

items.title: Robotic Assessment of Thumb Proprioception after Stroke: Reliability, Validity, and Sensitivity.
items.summary: A novel robotic assessment (SCJ) for thumb proprioception in chronic stroke survivors demonstrated good reliability, validity, and sensitivity, identifying deficits in 61% of participants, significantly more than the FMA-S.
items.curatedReason: 中风后腕部本体感觉评估，用了新器械，比老方法（FMA-S）更能查出问题，是给康复的定心丸。
items.titleZh: 机器人评估中风后拇指本体感觉：可靠性、有效性与敏感性
items.summaryZh: 一种新颖的机器人评估工具（SCJ）用于评估中风后慢性期患者的拇指本体感觉，显示出良好的可靠性、有效性和敏感性，能识别出61%的患者存在本体感觉缺陷，远高于FMA-S。
items.curatedReasonEn: The development of a reliable, valid, and sensitive robotic assessment for thumb proprioception post-stroke is a significant advancement. This tool's ability to detect deficits in a higher percentage of patients than traditional measures like the FMA-S will likely improve the characterization of sensory impairments and inform more targeted rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究使用了临床试验的基线数据和特定的机器人评估（SCJ），需要在更广泛的卒中人群中进一步验证，并与其他高级评估工具进行比较。
items.limitationEn: The study used baseline data from a clinical trial and a specific robotic assessment (SCJ), requiring further validation in broader stroke populations and comparison with other advanced assessment tools.

items.title: Prone positioning and high-frequency oscillatory ventilation in early paediatric acute respiratory distress syndrome (PROSpect): an international, two-by-two factorial, response-adaptive, phase 3, randomised controlled trial
items.summary: The PROSpect trial found no evidence that prone positioning or HFOV improve ventilator-free days in early, moderate-to-severe PARDS, recommending against their routine use as first-line strategies.
items.curatedReason: 重症新生儿呼吸窘迫综合征（PARDS），俯卧位和高频振荡通气（HFOV）不是首选，别常规用了。
items.titleZh: 俯卧位和高频振荡通气在早期儿童急性呼吸窘迫综合征（PROSpect）：一项国际性、2x2 析因、反应适应性、III 期、随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: PROSpect试验未发现俯卧位或高频振荡通气能改善早期、中重度儿童急性呼吸窘迫综合征（PARDS）的无通气天数，因此不推荐将其作为一线策略常规使用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The PROSpect trial provides high-level evidence that prone positioning and HFOV are not recommended as first-line strategies for early, moderate-to-severe PARDS, directly impacting clinical guidelines and practice for pediatric critical care. This finding challenges previous assumptions and directs care toward alternative approaches.
items.limitation: 本研究侧重于早期、中度至重度PARDS，并以脱离呼吸机天数作为主要结局，研究结果可能无法直接推广至其他PARDS严重程度或不同的结局指标。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on early, moderate-to-severe PARDS and used ventilator-free days as the primary outcome, and findings may not directly translate to other PARDS severity levels or different outcome measures.

items.title: Discussing pain increases at the point of exercise prescription: a clinical commentary for persistent musculoskeletal conditions.
items.summary: A clinical commentary suggests that clinicians should proactively discuss potential symptom aggravation with patients when prescribing exercise for persistent musculoskeletal pain, as current evidence does not support universal pain-monitoring rules.
items.curatedReason: 别迷信疼痛阈值，跟患者说清楚练了可能痛，让他们自己做好准备。
items.titleZh: 讨论运动处方时的疼痛增加：关于持续性肌肉骨骼疾病的临床评论
items.summaryZh: 本文提出，在为持续性肌肉骨骼疼痛患者开具运动处方时，应提前与患者讨论运动可能导致的症状加重，因为现有证据不支持通用的疼痛监测规则。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary provides a crucial clinical framework for addressing exercise-induced pain in persistent musculoskeletal conditions. It emphasizes proactive patient education and shared decision-making rather than relying on unproven universal pain thresholds, which is essential for improving adherence and confidence.
items.limitation: 本评论基于定性推理和现有文献回顾，呼吁未来研究验证具体的指导和沟通策略。
items.limitationEn: The commentary is based on qualitative reasoning and a review of existing literature, with a call for future research to validate specific instructions and communication strategies.

items.title: Calibrating clinical reasoning under uncertainty: a qualitative study of expert physiotherapists in musculoskeletal practice.
items.summary: Expert physiotherapists use flexible clinical scripts, calibrate judgment with diverse cues, and employ provisional decisions to manage uncertainty in musculoskeletal practice, transforming ambiguity into actionable clinical judgments.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，在面对骨科不确定性时，专家倾向于灵活运用临床脚本、结合多种线索校准判断，并给出初步的治疗决策。这为你处理类似模糊情况提供了借鉴，但仍需更多高质量研究来证实其普适性。
items.titleZh: 在不确定性下校准临床推理：一项针对肌肉骨骼实践中专家物理治疗师的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 专家物理治疗师通过灵活运用临床脚本、结合多种线索校准判断以及采取暂时性决策来管理不确定性，从而将模糊情况转化为可操作的临床判断。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that experts navigate musculoskeletal uncertainty using flexible clinical scripts, calibrating judgment with diverse cues, and employing provisional decisions. While offering a potential framework for managing ambiguity, more robust research is needed to generalize these findings.
items.limitation: 本研究依赖于对假设性情景的书面论证，且样本量小，仅涉及少数高度专业化的专家，限制了特定推理策略的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study relies on written justifications for hypothetical vignettes and involves a small sample of highly specialized experts, limiting the generalizability of specific reasoning strategies.

items.title: The cost-effectiveness of motivational interviewing to activate pain support in veterans seeking compensation for musculoskeletal conditions: multisite randomised clinical trial
items.summary: A multisite randomized clinical trial (n=1101) found that a motivational interviewing intervention costing $300 per participant increased the use of physical therapy and other musculoskeletal services, raising healthcare system costs by $US1,508 (p<0.001), but had no significant effect on total societal costs or preference-rated quality of life over 36 weeks, thus not being cost-effective in the short-term.
items.curatedReason: 一项针对退伍军人的多中心随机临床试验发现，动机性访谈虽然增加了物理治疗、脊柱手法、针灸等服务的使用，但也显著增加了医疗系统成本。鉴于其对生活质量的无显著影响且短期内不具成本效益，临床实践中应审慎评估其价值。
items.titleZh: 动机性访谈在激活寻求肌肉骨骼疾病补偿的退伍军人疼痛支持中的成本效益：一项多中心随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心随机临床试验（n=1101）发现，每位参与者花费 300 美元的动机性访谈干预增加了物理治疗及其他肌肉骨骼服务的使用，使医疗系统成本增加 1,508 美元（p<0.001），但对总社会成本或偏好评定的生活质量在 36 周内无显著影响，因此短期内不具成本效益。
items.curatedReasonEn: A multisite RCT in veterans found that motivational interviewing increased the use of PT, spinal manipulation, and acupuncture but significantly raised healthcare system costs. Given no significant impact on quality of life and short-term non-cost-effectiveness, its value in clinical practice warrants careful consideration.
items.limitation: 该试验的成本效益评估仅限于 36 周的短期随访，长期效果和成本效益尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The cost-effectiveness evaluation in this trial was limited to a short 36-week follow-up, leaving long-term effects and cost-effectiveness unknown.

items.title: Here are the Speech Language Therapy Coding Changes Going Into Effect on January 1, 2027
items.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, CPT code 92507 for speech-language therapy will be deleted and replaced by ten new, more specific codes covering fluency, speech sound production, language, and voice/upper airway disorders, according to the AMA's CPT Editorial Panel.
items.curatedReason: WebPT 发布的这则新闻非常关键：自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起，言语语言治疗 CPT 代码 92507 将被废止，并被十个更具体的代码取代。虽然是 SLP 相关，但它标志着美国医疗编码体系的重大变化，对你理解跨专业诊疗、尤其是涉及联合报销的 PT 执业具有重要参考意义。
items.titleZh: 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效的言语语言治疗编码变更
items.summaryZh: 根据 AMA 的 CPT 编辑委员会，自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起，言语语言治疗 CPT 代码 92507 将被废止，并由十个针对流利度、言语发音、语言及声音/上气道障碍的新代码取代。
items.curatedReasonEn: This WebPT news is crucial: effective January 1, 2027, CPT code 92507 for speech-language therapy will be deleted and replaced by ten more specific codes. While SLP-specific, it marks a significant change in US medical coding, offering important insights for your understanding of interprofessional practice, especially regarding joint reimbursement.

items.title: Efficacy of whole-body vibration training in the management of patients with COPD: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 15 RCTs found that whole-body vibration training significantly improved 6-minute walk distance (MD = 34.35 m; 95% CI: 13.67, 55.04) and 5-repetition sit-to-stand test performance (MD = -5.95 seconds; 95% CI: -10.76, -1.14) in COPD patients compared to usual care, but not when compared to active exercise interventions.
items.curatedReason: 全身体振动训练（WBVT）对 COPD 患者的益处有限，仅在与无康复对照组相比时才观察到步距和坐站能力的改善。不应将其作为常规运动康复的替代方案。
items.titleZh: 全身体振动训练对 COPD 患者管理疗效的系统评价和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 15 项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，全身体振动训练能显著改善 COPD 患者的 6 分钟步行距离（平均差 = 34.35 米；95% CI：13.67，55.04）和 5 次坐站测试表现（平均差 = -5.95 秒；95% CI：-10.76，-1.14），但仅在与常规护理相比时有效，与主动运动干预相比则无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Whole-body vibration training (WBVT) shows limited benefits for COPD patients, with improvements in walking distance and sit-to-stand performance observed only when compared to no rehabilitation. It should not replace conventional exercise-based pulmonary rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 纳入研究存在高偏倚风险，证据确定性为低到极低。
items.limitationEn: Included studies had a high risk of bias, and evidence certainty ranged from low to very low.

items.title: Dizziness, Lower Limb Weakness, and Falls in COPD: A Prospective Longitudinal Pilot Study Using Monthly Home Diaries.
items.summary: A prospective longitudinal pilot study (n=27) found that monthly home diary monitoring of dizziness and lower limb weakness showed higher apparent discrimination for predicting falls in COPD patients than single-visit baseline assessments, with dizziness having the strongest discrimination (AUC = 0.813).
items.curatedReason: 对于 COPD 患者，每月通过日记监测头晕和下肢无力等症状，可能比单次评估更能有效识别跌倒风险，这提示了一种低成本的补充性筛查方法。
items.titleZh: COPD 患者的头晕、下肢无力和跌倒：一项使用每月居家日记的前瞻性纵向初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性纵向初步研究（n=27）发现，每月通过居家日记监测头晕和下肢无力，在预测 COPD 患者跌倒方面的区分度高于单次基线评估，其中头晕的区分度最强（AUC = 0.813）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For COPD patients, monthly diary-recorded symptom monitoring (e.g., dizziness, lower limb weakness) may offer better fall risk discrimination than single-visit assessments, suggesting a low-cost, complementary screening approach.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的初步观察性研究（n=27），结果具有探索性且可能存在偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a small pilot observational study (n=27), making the findings exploratory and potentially biased.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Interprofessional communication and early rehabilitation practices in orthopaedic surgery: a cross-sectional survey
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 84 orthopedic surgeons and 513 physiotherapists in Türkiye revealed that despite 96.4% of surgeons acknowledging the importance of early physiotherapy, only 27.4% reported initiation within 0-3 postoperative days, and nearly half of both groups reported low direct communication.
items.curatedReason: 尽管骨科医生和物理治疗师都认识到早期康复的重要性，但本研究揭示了土耳其在术后康复启动时间及医患沟通实践上的显著差异，提示行业在标准化流程和跨专业协作上仍有待改进。
items.titleZh: 骨科手术中的跨专业沟通与早期康复实践：一项横断面调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对土耳其 84 名骨科医生和 513 名物理治疗师的横断面调查显示，尽管 96.4% 的外科医生认识到早期物理治疗的重要性，但只有 27.4% 的人报告在术后 0-3 天内开始康复，且近半数受访者表示直接沟通不足。
items.curatedReasonEn: Despite awareness of early rehabilitation's importance, this study highlights significant variations in post-operative rehabilitation timing and interprofessional communication practices in Türkiye, suggesting a need for improved standardization and collaboration.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面调查，只能揭示相关性而非因果关系，且可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional survey, which can only show correlations, not causation, and may be subject to recall bias.

items.title: How ChoosePT Turns PTs' Expertise Into Trusted Public Resources
items.summary: APTA's ChoosePT.com serves as a consumer-focused resource providing free, reliable, evidence-based health information on physical therapy, with content reviewed by board-certified specialists like Anna V. Howard, PT, BS, PCS, a pediatric clinical specialist.
items.curatedReason: 在向患者家庭解释儿童物理治疗时，你可以直接引用 APTA 的 ChoosePT.com。这个网站内容经过专家评审，能为家长提供可靠的循证信息，省去了你自行寻找科普素材的时间。
items.titleZh: ChoosePT 如何将物理治疗师的专业知识转化为值得信赖的公共资源
items.summaryZh: APTA 的 ChoosePT.com 网站是一个面向大众的资源平台，提供免费、可靠、循证的物理治疗健康信息，其内容由 Anna V. Howard 博士等经专业认证的儿科临床专家负责评审。
items.curatedReasonEn: When explaining pediatric physical therapy to patient families, direct them to APTA's ChoosePT.com. The expert-reviewed, evidence-based content will save you time in finding reliable educational materials for parents.

items.title: Validation and prognostic value of the five-repetition sit-to-stand test in patients with severe exacerbation of COPD.
items.summary: A prospective observational study (n=58) found the 5STS test correlated with quadriceps force (r = -0.487) and 6MWT (r = -0.415) in severe ECOPD patients, showing acceptable prognostic value (AUC 0.720, 95% CI: 0.588-0.853) for predicting 6-month exacerbation-related readmission with a ≥13 seconds cutoff.
items.curatedReason: 五次坐站测试（5STS）在评估慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重患者的功能和预测再入院风险方面显示出潜力。这为临床 PT 提供了一个简单、低成本的评估工具，帮助识别高风险患者。
items.titleZh: 五次坐站测试在重度慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重患者中的验证和预后价值
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察研究（n=58）显示，五次坐站测试（5STS）与股四头肌力量（r = -0.487）和六分钟步行测试（r = -0.415）在重度慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重患者中存在显著负相关，且具有可接受的预后价值（AUC 0.720，95% CI: 0.588-0.853），能预测六个月内再入院风险，临界值为≥13秒。
items.curatedReasonEn: The five-repetition sit-to-stand (5STS) test demonstrates potential for assessing physical function and predicting readmission risk in patients with severe exacerbation of COPD. This provides a simple, low-cost assessment tool for clinical physical therapists to identify high-risk patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心观察性研究，样本量较小（n=58），可能影响结果的普遍性，且未报告干预效果。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center observational study with a small sample size (n=58), which may limit the generalizability of the findings and did not report intervention effects.

items.title: Predicting Robot-Based Tracking Performance After Stroke Using Lesion Features and Clinical Assessments: A Pilot Study
items.summary: A pilot study (n=18) found clinical assessments significantly predicted robot-based tracking error (R^2=0.45) in chronic stroke patients, outperforming lesion features. Attention- and motor-related measures were identified as the strongest predictors.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究表明，临床评估在预测卒中后机器人辅助追踪表现方面优于单纯的病灶特征。临床PT可继续关注患者的运动和认知功能，将其作为康复预后的关键指标，并期待未来更大样本的研究提供更精确的影像预测价值。
items.titleZh: 基于病灶特征和临床评估预测卒中后机器人辅助追踪表现：一项初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项初步研究（n=18）发现，在慢性卒中患者中，临床评估显著预测机器人辅助追踪误差（R^2=0.45），优于单纯的病灶特征。注意力与运动相关指标被确定为最强预测因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study suggests that clinical assessments are superior to lesion features alone in predicting robot-based tracking performance after stroke. Clinical PTs should continue to prioritize motor and cognitive functional assessments as key indicators for rehabilitation prognosis, while awaiting larger studies for more precise imaging predictive value.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本（n=18）探索性试点研究，且关注的是机器人辅助追踪表现的替代终点，其结果外推至真实世界功能性康复效果需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This was a small-sample (n=18) exploratory pilot study focusing on a surrogate endpoint of robot-based tracking performance; therefore, generalizing these results to real-world functional rehabilitation outcomes should be done with caution.
